raw_text: Copernicus Emergency Management Service activated for Kakhovka Dam breach. Rapid mapping product EMSR-672 shows flood extent along Dnipro River. Affected area estimated at 600 square kilometers. Water depth in Nova Kakhovka township exceeds 3 meters. Downstream impact extends to Kherson city suburbs.
